# Notification Decisions Note 2

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that notification handling of suppression interacts with retrypolicy; teams noted that fanout depends on inbox and deliverability, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that notification handling of template interacts with escalation; teams noted that webhook depends on bounce and digestcadence, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that notification handling of throttling interacts with opt-in; teams noted that unsubscribe depends on channel and preference, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, notification handling of deeplink interacts with deliverywindow; teams noted that quiethours depends on push and mute, especially under real production load.
